After her husband Calvin took the office of Vice President in 1920 the Coolidges rejected the donation of a Vice Presidential Mansion (as a major position by Coolidge was to reject such excess expenditure in favor of budget cuts/smaller government). Instead the Coolidges opted to rent room in The Willard hotel.

The Coolidges were country people not used to such urban living, firstly their children, now teenagers would not be able to live with them, secondly, and more difficult for the Coolidges to accept was that pets were disallowed in the hotel.

However Grace Coolidge soon found a way around the "No Animals" policy.

One evening Grace found tiny consolation in the form of a family of mice who had found their way into the room. The mice returned often, and Grace fed them bits from the hotel table. The other visitors might criticize her etiquette, but in the mice, "I firmly believe that I thus acquired some friends in Washington who would have pronounced me the perfect hostess"
